decisions.rationale: The agent can draft the RFP document based on standard industry requirements and evaluation criteria.
The agent can design a supplier evaluation scorecard with weighted criteria.
The agent can analyze and compare the provided documents against the scorecard.
Signing a purchase order requires legal authority.
Negotiation calls require human interaction and relationship management.
Agents can analyze data and draft negotiation strategies based on project information.
Only the user has access to the internal approved budget figures.
The agent prepares the registration data, but a human must perform the action in the external system.
The agent can analyze the document and identify risks and clauses independently.
The agent can compare documents and identify discrepancies against company policy.
The agent can draft the document and checklist for review.
Signing a legal agreement requires human authority.
The agent can summarize the contract document into an executive summary in Arabic.
Legal counsel must exercise professional authority to approve legal redlines.
The agent can draft legal redlines and alternative wording based on standard contract analysis.
Agent prepares the file, but human must access the restricted contract management system.
Agents can draft informational content based on provided customer questions.
The agent can draft professional customer service responses in both Arabic and English.
Agent provides configuration plan, human performs setup in external system requiring account access.
The agent can design the matrix and define response targets based on standard industry practices.
Training requires physical presence and live interaction at the office.
Agents can generate training materials and scenarios based on provided information.
Official business hours and holidays are internal company policies known only to management.
Defining KPIs and report templates is an analytical task suitable for an AI agent.
The agent can create a comprehensive transition schedule and task list for departments.
Physical task requiring manual handling of IT equipment.
